character: Traditional Savoyard village, authentic charm, La Bouitte ★★ Michelin (René & Maxime Meilleur), Simple & Meilleur bistro (Bib Gourmand). Heritage trail, Sunday market, 17th-century Baroque sanctuary.
description: Saint-Martin-de-Belleville is the most authentic village in the Belleville valley. Traditional stone architecture, narrow streets, a Sunday market, and a local atmosphere the purpose-built resorts lack. Home to La Bouitte — ★★ Michelin gastronomic restaurant and 5-star Relais & Châteaux hotel run by father-son team René & Maxime Meilleur. The Simple & Meilleur bistro (Bib Gourmand) serves family recipes. Notre-Dame-de-la-Vie sanctuary (17th-century Baroque with frescoes by Nicolas Oudéard, recently restored). Heritage trail (5km, 12 stops). Village museum in former farmhouse. Quiet, authentic, unspoilt.

non_ski_activities.la_bouitte: La Bouitte ★★ Michelin — René & Maxime Meilleur, father-son chef duo. 5-star Relais & Châteaux hotel. Mountain Nature Spa. La Table des Meilleurs gastronomic restaurant. Simple & Meilleur bistro (Bib Gourmand, family recipes, local specialties, wine cellar).
non_ski_activities.heritage_trail: 5km, 12 stops through the old village, monuments, and historic community sites. 2-hour walk.
non_ski_activities.museum: Village museum in former farmhouse — traces over a century of valley history, from farming to international resort.
non_ski_activities.sanctuary: Notre-Dame-de-la-Vie — magnificent recently restored 17th-century Baroque sanctuary. Frescoes by Nicolas Oudéard, altarpiece by Jean-Marie Molino. Major pilgrimage destination. One of finest Baroque buildings in Savoie.
non_ski_activities.market: Sunday market — local produce, Savoyard cheeses, crafts

honest_drawbacks: Lower altitude (1,400m) — requires lifts to reach main ski area
Shuttle needed to Les Menuires/Val Thorens lifts
Small village — fewer restaurants than larger resorts
